title: Computer Use
description: Let AI in your current conversation observe or operate a local app. Choose a window and permissions, then return to chat to give instructions.
unsupported: Computer Use currently supports Windows x64 only. Other features are unaffected.
noWindows: No application windows found. Open an app, then refresh the list.
ownershipMismatch: Another conversation still owns control; access has not moved to this conversation. End the previous authorization before granting again.
currentSession: The currently loaded conversation (check before authorizing)
noSession: Create or open a conversation in the sidebar, then return here to authorize it.
foreground: Continuous: allow mouse and keyboard use
permissionWarning: Observation does not grant input access. Actions may change app data or send information; important operations still follow chat approval rules. Window selection is not a system sandbox.
chat: Return to chat to give instructions
noTarget: No conversation has been authorized to control an application.
backgroundHelp: Not every app can run while hidden. AI pauses when an action requires the foreground, capture fails, or the target becomes invalid. Restoring a window does not end the task; confirm control before continuing. Allowing further actions restores permission without starting a new model turn; return to chat and ask to continue if AI already ended its turn. Screenshots require an image-capable model; text-only models can use the accessibility tree.
shortcutHelp: Use the system tray to recall the main window, stop control, or restore apps. Stop and recall shortcuts are configurable in Settings. Topmost windows temporarily yield during physical input.
shortcutsUnavailable: Some system shortcuts are not registered or are already in use. Use the stop and restore actions in the system tray.

phases.disabled: Computer Use is off. This feature grants no desktop access.
phases.idle: Enabled. Choose an application and authorize a conversation.
phases.ready: Authorized. Waiting for AI actions from chat.
phases.running: AI is observing or operating the application. You may pause or take control at any time.
phases.stopping: Stopping and waiting for backend and input-release confirmation. Control cannot continue or transfer before acknowledgement.
phases.paused: Paused. Confirm the app state before continuing.
phases.user: You have control. AI will not continue operating.
phases.needs-foreground: Foreground access is required. Restore the window, select mouse and keyboard permission, and authorize again.
phases.error: Control cannot continue. See the message below.

errors.generic: Computer use is temporarily unavailable. Permissions have not been expanded. Retry status, or end and restore windows.
errors.backend_not_bundled: The computer use backend is missing. In development, prepare bundled resources; for installed builds, reinstall the complete Windows version.
errors.backend_integrity_failed: Backend integrity verification failed. Nothing was started. Reinstall the complete version.
errors.needs_foreground: This action needs a visible target and foreground input permission. Restore the window and authorize again.
errors.stale_target: The target closed or changed identity. Refresh and select it again; a reused window handle will not be trusted.
errors.stale_reference: The application changed. Ask AI to observe again before acting.
errors.user_takeover: Your activity was detected and AI yielded control. Confirm the state before continuing.
errors.stop_failed: Backend stop or input release is not yet confirmed. Further actions are blocked. Try ending the task again; do not continue before confirmation.
errors.restore_failed: Some windows could not be restored. Recovery records were preserved. Try restoring all again.
errors.recovery_failed: Window recovery records could not be read, so startup was blocked. Repair the recovery records and restart the app.
errors.invalid_session: This conversation is no longer running. Open it before granting access.
errors.desktop_owned: Another conversation still owns control. End its authorization before switching.
errors.recall_unavailable: Neither the tray nor recall shortcut is available. The main window will remain visible so you can stop and recover.
errors.capture_unavailable: The target image cannot be captured reliably. Pixels from other windows will not be substituted.
